Problem Statement:
You are given a string. Remove all the vowels from the string and print the resulting string. 
Input Description:
A single line string containing only alphabets (both uppercase and lowercase allowed). 
Output Description:
Print the new string after removing all vowels (a, e, i, o, u, in both uppercase and lowercase). 
Sample Input:
hello 
Sample Output:
hll
